# SupportAware-Topo screening

## Transformation

Original Topo (unchanged):

$$\mu^{\mathrm{Topo}} = A \cdot R_{\mathrm{opp}}$$

SupportAware-Topo (unit-information Laplace / credibility shrinkage toward 1):

$$c(n_{\mathrm{opp}}) = \frac{n_{\mathrm{opp}}}{n_{\mathrm{opp}}+\lambda},\quad \lambda=1$$

$$R_{\mathrm{opp}}^{S} = c\cdot R_{\mathrm{opp}} + (1-c)\cdot 1$$

$$\mu^{\mathrm{Topo\text{-}S}} = A \cdot R_{\mathrm{opp}}^{S},\qquad w = \mathrm{CW}(y)\, \mu^{\mathrm{Topo\text{-}S}}$$

`λ = 1.0`, prior = 1.0 (not tuned per dataset).

Low `n_opp` reduces the influence of `R_opp`. High `n_opp` recovers original Topo.
`R_opp = 0` with `n_opp = 0` yields `R_opp^S = 1`, so CA is not fully suppressed.
